title: Run attach
description: The body of the signed POST to <run.url>/<run_id>/attach, application/json, with which the gateway a run key names takes the run on: the run key, and what the run tells the server of itself, which a registration through a gateway leaves out. It is signed by the gateway's access key under qory-request-ed25519-v1. The answer is a signed 200 whose body is run-attach-answer.schema.json. The gateway builds the body once and sends the same bytes on every try, time included; the signature covers the body, and a server refuses a time outside 300 seconds of its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses a version it does not read.

run_key.description: The run's run key, at most 2048 characters, whose run_id is the path's: run-key.schema.json is its payload.

interval_seconds.description: The heartbeat interval the run uses, in seconds: the run's liveness counts from it. A larger value fails the schema, a signed 400 invalid_request.

events.description: The event types the server receives, as its configuration lists them.

forager_version.description: The Forager module version, as Go stamps it.

contract_version.description: The revision of this contract Forager implements, the same integer as the X-Qory-Contract-Version header.

time.description: When the gateway built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. A server refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.
